headline: Binance Hack and AI Spending Fears Trigger Tech and Crypto Selloff
summary: A reported $6.3 billion Binance hack rattles cryptocurrency markets, while weak earnings outlooks and mounting concerns over artificial intelligence spending push the Nasdaq-100 ETF down over 2%.
why: Binance is one of the world's largest cryptocurrency exchanges, and major security breaches or market-wide tech spending corrections can significantly impact digital asset valuations and investor sentiment across the technology sector.

impacts.name: Invesco QQQ Trust
impacts.why: Weak earnings outlooks and AI spending concerns drag down the broader tech-heavy QQQ index.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The combination of a massive $6.3 billion security breach on a major crypto platform and growing investor anxiety over high AI capital expenditures relative to earnings outlooks directly drove broad-based declines in crypto and tech equities.
